The Grünwald reach

WikiTree records 15,500 people descended from Christoph Grünwald through linked parent–child records:

This counts only what volunteers have entered on WikiTree. The real number of Christoph's descendants alive today is far higher, probably tens of thousands.

Click a person

Click a name to see their details. Click the small circle on a person to open or close their parents.

↺ means this person already appears elsewhere in your tree. You descend from them more than once, which happens a lot in old Cape families.

Dashed names are unproven claims.

A family view: the person in green is in focus, with their parents above, their brothers and sisters beside them, their spouse(s) in white next to them, and their children below. Click anyone to move the focus to them. A + means that person has children recorded.

How it split

Follow the green boxes from Christoph down to you. Every white box is a brother or sister of your ancestor. Their descendants are your cousins.

Click a white box to see their spouse, children and story, and to open their branch.
